Create an interactive horizontal lollipop chart

Source: R/horzLollipop.R
horz_lollipop.Rd

The horizontal version of lollipop_chart(): categories are listed down the left side, which suits many categories and long labels. It has the same features (groups, aggregation, value labels, sort buttons, tooltips, legend); see lollipop_chart() for the interactions and the Shiny inputs.

Usage

horz_lollipop(
  data,
  label,
  value = NULL,
  sort = "none",
  bgcol = "white",
  valueTicks = NULL,
  labelTicks = NULL,
  valueFontSize = 11,
  labelFontSize = 12,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  valueTitle = NULL,
  valueTitleFontSize = 13,
  labelTitle = NULL,
  labelTitleFontSize = 13,
  title = NULL,
  titleFontSize = 20,
  lineStroke = NULL,
  lineStrokeWidth = 2,
  circleFill = NULL,
  circleStroke = NULL,
  circleStrokeWidth = 1.5,
  circleRadius = 6,
  axisCol = "#333333",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  agg = c("sum", "mean", "median", "min", "max", "count"),
  labels = TRUE,
  highlight = NULL,
  refLines = NULL,
  negativeFill = NULL,
  legend = NULL,
  controls = TRUE,
  tooltip = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  valueFormat = NULL,
  valuePrefix = "",
  valueSuffix = "",
  subtitle = NULL,
  subtitleFontSize = 13,
  gridCol = "#e9e9e9",
  opacity = 1
)

Arguments

data

The data frame containing the variables to consider.

label

The name of the categorical variable, listed on the y-axis.

value

The name of the numeric variable, plotted along the x-axis. When NULL, the rows of each category are counted.

sort

The initial order of the lollipops: "none" (default, the order of the data or of the factor levels), "ascending" or "descending". Descending puts the largest value at the top.

bgcol

The background color of the SVG. Defaults to "white".

valueTicks

Optional. The approximate number of value axis ticks.

labelTicks

Not used; kept for compatibility.

valueFontSize

The font size of the value axis labels. Defaults to 11.

labelFontSize

The font size of the category labels. Defaults to 12.

font

The font family to consider for the titles. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

valueTitle

Optional. The title of the value axis. Defaults to the name of value (or "Count"); use "" to hide it.

valueTitleFontSize

The font size of the value axis title. Defaults to 13.

labelTitle

Optional. The title of the category axis, drawn above the labels.

labelTitleFontSize

The font size of the category axis title. Defaults to 13.

title

Optional. The title of the plot.

titleFontSize

The font size of the plot title. Defaults to 20.

lineStroke

Optional. The colour of the stems. Defaults to the colour of the dots.

lineStrokeWidth

The width of the stems, in pixels. Defaults to 2.

circleFill

The colour of the dots. A single colour, or, without group, one colour per category (recycled; a named vector maps colours to categories). With group, one colour per group (a named vector maps colours to groups). Defaults to a built-in palette.

circleStroke

Optional. The colour of the ring around the dots. Defaults to the background colour.

circleStrokeWidth

The width of the ring around the dots. Defaults to 1.5.

circleRadius

The radius of the dots, in pixels. Defaults to 6. Dots are made smaller when there is not enough room for them.

axisCol

The colour of the axes, labels and titles. Defaults to "#333333".

width

Optional. The width of the SVG output.

height

Optional. The height of the SVG output.

group

Optional. The name of a column that splits each category into groups, drawn side by side (one colour per group, with a clickable legend).

agg

How rows with the same category (and group) are combined: "sum" (default), "mean", "median", "min", "max" or "count". With one row per bar, every option but "count" returns the value itself.

labels

Logical. Write the values next to the dots (when every label fits). Defaults to TRUE.

highlight

Optional. A character vector of categories to emphasise; the other lollipops are drawn in grey (or faded, with group).

refLines

Optional. Numeric values drawn as dashed reference lines across the bars (e.g. a target or an average); names are used as labels.

negativeFill

Optional. The colour of negative lollipops (without group).

legend

Logical. Show the legend. When NULL (default), it is shown when group is used.

controls

Logical. Show the sort buttons. Defaults to TRUE.

tooltip

Logical. Show a tooltip on hover. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Logical. Animate the lollipops when the chart is first drawn. Defaults to TRUE.

valueFormat

Optional. A d3-format string for the values, e.g. ",.0f", ".1f" or "~s".

valuePrefix, valueSuffix

Optional. Text added before or after every value, e.g. "$" or " km".

subtitle

Optional. A subtitle drawn under the title.

subtitleFontSize

The font size of the subtitle. Defaults to 13.

gridCol

The colour of the grid lines. Defaults to "#e9e9e9"; use NA to hide them.

opacity

The opacity of the lollipops (from 0 to 1). Defaults to 1.

Value

An interactive SVG horizontal lollipop chart (an r2d3 htmlwidget).

Examples

library(ggplot2) # needed for the mpg data frame
library(dplyr) # needed for data wrangling

mpg %>% group_by(manufacturer) %>%
  summarise(median_cty = median(cty)) %>%
  horz_lollipop(
    label = "manufacturer",
    value = "median_cty",
    sort = "descending",
    title = "Median city miles per gallon"
  )



# Count rows, with an average line
counts <- count(mpg, manufacturer)
horz_lollipop(
  mpg, label = "manufacturer", sort = "descending",
  refLines = c(Average = mean(counts$n)),
  title = "Models per manufacturer"
)



# Positive and negative values
change <- data.frame(
  country = c("Spain", "France", "Italy", "Germany", "Poland", "Sweden"),
  growth  = c(2.4, 0.9, -0.3, -0.6, 3.1, 1.2)
)
horz_lollipop(
  change, label = "country", value = "growth",
  sort = "descending", negativeFill = "#ff725c",
  valueSuffix = "%", valueTitle = "GDP growth",
  title = "Annual GDP growth"
)
